title: Static Wide-Bill Flat-Tail Platypus
description: One newly authored whole stylised platypus-like animal in a fixed low four-foot pose. A long rounded low body narrows continuously into a small forward head without a raised bird neck. Its front carries a broad flattened rounded bill and its rear a very wide flat thick paddle tail. Four short splayed leg-to-web-foot solids connect the low torso to full fan-shaped grounded soles, unlike seal flippers or a two-foot duck. Two small side eyes sit behind the bill. New whole body, paddle, feet and bill outlines; no old seal or waterfowl arrays reused. One static animal prop, zero scenes. Static artistic appearance only, no exact species, anatomical, biological, gait, swimming, burrowing or animal-handling claim.
